recipes.name: Spaghetti alla carbonara
recipes.blurb: Silky Roman pasta built from eggs, cheese, and crisped guanciale - no cream needed.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Cut the guanciale into short strips and render slowly in a dry pan until golden and crisp.
Whisk the whole eggs with the grated pecorino and a generous amount of cracked pepper into a paste.
Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti and toss it into the pan with the guanciale off the heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir quickly, loosening with splashes of pasta water until a glossy sauce coats every strand.
Serve at once with extra pecorino and pepper.

recipes.name: Margherita pizza
recipes.blurb: A blistered, chewy crust dressed simply with tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, and salt, then add about 320 ml warm water and the oil to form a shaggy dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise until doubled, around an hour.
Divide into two balls, shape, and rest while you heat the oven as hot as it will go with a stone or steel inside.
Crush the tomatoes with a pinch of salt for a quick sauce.
Stretch each ball into a thin round, spread with sauce, and dot with torn mozzarella.
Bake until the crust is charred and puffed, then finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.name: Lasagna bolognese
recipes.blurb: Layered ribbons of pasta, slow-cooked meat ragu, and creamy bechamel baked until bubbling.
steps: Soften the diced onion and carrot in oil, then brown both meats until no pink remains.
Add the tomatoes, season, and simmer the ragu gently for at least an hour until rich and thick.
Make a bechamel by melting the butter, whisking in flour, then slowly adding warm milk until smooth.
Spread a little ragu in a baking dish, then layer pasta, ragu, bechamel, and parmesan.
Repeat the layers, finishing with bechamel and a heavy dusting of parmesan.
Bake until golden and bubbling, then rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Risotto ai funghi
recipes.blurb: Creamy slow-stirred rice perfumed with mushrooms and finished with parmesan.
steps: Saute the sliced mushrooms in butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften the finely chopped onion, add the rice, and toast it for a minute until translucent at the edges.
Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until each addition is absorbed and the rice is creamy but still firm.
Fold the mushrooms back in along with the parmesan and a knob of butter.
Rest briefly, then serve loose and creamy.

recipes.name: Chicken tacos al pastor
recipes.blurb: Marinated chicken charred and tucked into warm tortillas with pineapple and onion.
steps: Soak the dried chiles in hot water, then blend with garlic, cumin, a little pineapple, and salt into a smooth marinade.
Coat the chicken in the marinade and rest at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until charred and cooked through, then chop into small pieces.
Char the pineapple chunks in the same pan and dice the onion and cilantro.
Warm the tortillas until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, pineapple, onion, and cilantro, and serve with lime.

recipes.name: Beef chili con carne
recipes.blurb: A deep, smoky pot of beef and beans simmered low with dried chiles and cumin.
steps: Brown the beef in a heavy pot, breaking it up, then remove and set aside.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic, then stir in the chili powder and cumin until fragrant.
Return the beef, add the tomatoes and stock, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered for about 90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and deeply flavored.
Add the drained beans in the last 20 minutes and adjust the seasoning.
Serve hot with rice or cornbread.

recipes.name: Chiles rellenos
recipes.blurb: Roasted poblanos stuffed with cheese, cloaked in airy egg batter, and fried golden.
steps: Char the poblanos over a flame until blackened, then steam in a bag and peel off the skins.
Slit each pepper, remove the seeds, and stuff with cheese.
Simmer the tomatoes with onion and garlic into a light sauce.
Separate the eggs, beat the whites to stiff peaks, then fold in the yolks for the batter.
Dust the peppers in flour, coat in batter, and fry until golden on all sides.
Serve in the warm tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.blurb: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken simmered in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Marinate the cubed chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, and grated ginger and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until charred at the edges, then set aside.
Soften the onion, add the remaining spices and turmeric, and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the tomatoes and simmer until thick, then blend smooth if you prefer.
Return the chicken, pour in the cream, and simmer until cooked through and saucy.
Finish with a little extra garam masala and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Chana masala
recipes.blurb: Hearty chickpeas stewed in a tangy, spiced tomato gravy - a vegan staple.
steps: Soften the chopped onion in oil until deep golden.
Add the grated ginger and garlic and cook for a minute.
Stir in the cumin, turmeric, and garam masala until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook down into a thick paste.
Add the drained chickpeas with a splash of water and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy, then finish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Saag paneer
recipes.blurb: Soft cubes of paneer folded into a velvety spiced spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch the spinach briefly, then blend into a smooth puree.
Pan-fry the paneer cubes until lightly golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion with ginger and garlic, then add the cumin and garam masala.
Stir in the spinach puree and simmer gently for ten minutes.
Fold in the paneer and a swirl of cream and warm through.
Adjust the seasoning and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Lamb rogan josh
recipes.blurb: Tender lamb braised in an aromatic Kashmiri sauce stained deep red with chile.
steps: Brown the cubed lamb in batches and set aside.
Soften the onions deeply, then add the ginger, garlic, and ground spices.
Return the lamb and stir to coat in the spices.
Whisk in the yogurt a spoonful at a time to keep it from splitting.
Add a little water, cover, and braise gently for about 90 minutes until the lamb is fork tender.
Finish with garam masala and let it rest before serving.

recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
recipes.blurb: Wok-fried chicken with peanuts and dried chiles in a glossy sweet-savory sauce.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and toss with a little soy sauce and cornstarch.
Mix the remaining soy, vinegar, sugar, and a splash of water into a sauce.
Heat a wok until smoking and stir-fry the chicken until browned, then remove.
Fry the dried chiles, garlic, and ginger briefly until fragrant.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss until glossy and thickened.
Stir in the peanuts and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
recipes.blurb: Silky tofu in a numbing, spicy Sichuan sauce of fermented beans and chile oil.
steps: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns and grind them to a powder.
Brown the ground pork in oil until crisp.
Add the doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger and fry until the oil turns red.
Pour in stock or water and the soy sauce, then slide in the cubed tofu.
Simmer gently, then thicken with a cornstarch slurry.
Finish with the ground peppercorns and sliced scallions.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Tender sliced beef and crisp broccoli in a quick, glossy brown sauce.
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and toss with a little soy and cornstarch.
Blanch the broccoli florets briefly until bright green, then drain.
Mix the remaining soy, oyster sauce, and a splash of water into a sauce.
Sear the beef in a hot wok until just browned, then remove.
Fry the garlic and ginger, add the broccoli, then return the beef.
Pour in the sauce, toss until glossy, and finish with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Pad thai
recipes.blurb: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, egg, and tofu in a sweet-sour tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Mix the tamarind, fish sauce, and palm sugar into a sauce.
Fry the cubed tofu until golden, then add the shrimp and cook through.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs in the wok.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss over high heat until coated and tender.
Stir in the bean sprouts and serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

recipes.name: Thai green curry
recipes.blurb: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken, eggplant, and basil over jasmine rice.
steps: Simmer the thick top of the coconut milk until the oil separates.
Fry the curry paste in the coconut oil until deeply fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken and stir to coat.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, lime leaves, fish sauce, and sugar.
Add the eggplant and simmer until everything is tender.
Stir through the basil just before serving with jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu curry
recipes.blurb: Crisp panko chicken cutlets over rice with a mellow Japanese curry sauce.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and carrot, then stir in the curry powder and flour.
Add stock and soy sauce gradually, simmering into a smooth, thick curry sauce.
Flatten the chicken slightly, then coat in flour, egg, and panko.
Fry the cutlets in hot oil until golden and cooked through.
Slice the katsu into strips.
Serve over rice with the curry sauce poured alongside.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared salmon glazed in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar into a teriyaki sauce.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in a hot pan until crisp.
Flip and cook briefly, then pour off any excess oil.
Add the sauce and grated ginger and let it bubble and reduce.
Spoon the thickening glaze over the salmon until shiny.
Serve scattered with sliced scallions over rice.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.blurb: A vibrant Korean rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables, beef, and a fried egg.
steps: Season and brown the beef with soy sauce and a little sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach and dress with sesame oil and salt.
Saute the julienned carrots and the sliced mushrooms separately.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Mound the rice in bowls and arrange the vegetables and beef in sections on top.
Add an egg and a spoon of gochujang to each, then mix at the table.

recipes.name: Korean braised short ribs
recipes.blurb: Galbi-jjim: short ribs slow-braised in a sweet-savory soy broth until falling apart.
steps: Blanch the short ribs briefly to remove impurities, then rinse.
Blend the pear, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar into a braising liquid.
Combine the ribs and liquid in a pot with enough water to cover.
Braise gently for about two hours until the meat is tender.
Add the chunked carrots in the last 30 minutes.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and serve scattered with scallions.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced marinated chicken roasted and piled into wraps with garlic sauce.
steps: Mix the cumin, coriander, paprika, crushed garlic, lemon juice, and oil into a marinade.
Coat the chicken thighs and marinate for at least an hour.
Roast the chicken at high heat until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Rest, then slice into thin strips.
Warm the flatbreads.
Fill the wraps with chicken, salad, and a drizzle of garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta
recipes.blurb: Juicy spiced lamb skewers grilled until charred and served with herbs.
steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix the lamb with the onion, chopped parsley, garlic, and spices and season well.
Knead briefly until cohesive, then chill for 20 minutes.
Shape the mixture around skewers into long logs.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred outside and just cooked within.
Serve with flatbread, yogurt, and salad.

recipes.name: Mujadara
recipes.blurb: Humble, deeply savory lentils and rice crowned with sweet caramelized onions.
steps: Simmer the lentils until almost tender, then drain, reserving some liquid.
Slice the onions thinly and fry slowly in plenty of oil until deep brown and sweet.
Remove half the onions to use as a topping.
Add the rice and spices to the remaining onions and toast briefly.
Add the lentils and water to cover, then cook covered until the rice is fluffy.
Fluff and serve topped with the reserved crispy onions.

recipes.name: Greek chicken souvlaki
recipes.blurb: Lemon and oregano marinated chicken skewers grilled and served with tzatziki.
steps: Cube the chicken and marinate in lemon juice, oregano, garlic, and oil for an hour.
Grate and drain the cucumber, then mix with yogurt and garlic for tzatziki.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Rest the skewers briefly.
Serve with the tzatziki, warm pita, and a tomato salad.

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.blurb: Layers of eggplant and spiced lamb under a golden baked bechamel top.
steps: Slice and salt the eggplant, then roast or fry until soft and golden.
Brown the lamb with the onion, then add tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer into a thick sauce.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour, and milk, then whisk in the eggs off the heat.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish.
Pour the bechamel over the top and smooth it out.
Bake until deeply golden, then rest before slicing.

recipes.name: Coq au vin
recipes.blurb: Chicken braised slowly in red wine with mushrooms, bacon, and pearl onions.
steps: Render the chopped bacon, then brown the chicken in the fat and set aside.
Saute the pearl onions and mushrooms until golden, then remove.
Stir the flour into the pan, then deglaze with the red wine.
Return the chicken, bacon, garlic, and thyme and braise gently for about an hour.
Add the onions and mushrooms back in the last 20 minutes.
Swirl in the butter to gloss the sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon
recipes.blurb: Beef slow-braised in red wine until meltingly tender with mushrooms and onions.
steps: Render the bacon, then brown the cubed beef in batches and set aside.
Soften the carrots and garlic, then stir in the flour.
Deglaze with the wine, then return the beef, bacon, and stock.
Braise covered in a low oven for about two and a half hours until tender.
Saute the mushrooms and pearl onions separately and add near the end.
Skim any fat, adjust the seasoning, and serve with potatoes or bread.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.blurb: A sun-drenched Provencal stew of eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomato.
steps: Dice the eggplant, zucchini, and peppers into even pieces.
Fry each vegetable separately in oil until lightly browned, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer into a sauce.
Return all the vegetables and simmer gently until tender but not mushy.
Rest off the heat to let the flavors settle, then serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Smoky BBQ pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked pork shoulder pulled into tender shreds and tossed in tangy sauce.
steps: Rub the pork all over with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Place in a slow cooker over the sliced onion with the vinegar.
Cook on low for about eight hours until the meat is fork tender.
Lift out the pork and shred it with two forks, discarding excess fat.
Toss the shredded meat with the barbecue sauce and some cooking juices.
Pile onto buns with slaw.

recipes.name: Classic beef burgers
recipes.blurb: Juicy seared beef patties stacked with cheese and the usual fixings.
steps: Gently form the beef into four loose patties and season generously.
Press a small dimple in the center of each so they cook flat.
Sear in a screaming-hot pan or grill, flipping once, until well crusted.
Add cheese in the last minute and let it melt under a lid.
Toast the buns lightly.
Build each burger with lettuce, tomato, onion, and your favorite sauce.

recipes.name: Paella valenciana
recipes.blurb: Saffron rice studded with chicken, rabbit, beans, and a prized crisp socarrat.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil in a wide paella pan, then push to the side.
Saute the green beans and add the grated tomato and paprika, cooking into a sofrito.
Stir in the rice to coat in the flavored oil.
Pour in the hot saffron-infused stock and add the lima beans.
Simmer without stirring until the rice absorbs the liquid.
Raise the heat at the end to form a crisp socarrat, then rest before serving.

recipes.name: Spanish chicken and chorizo
recipes.blurb: One-pan braise of chicken, smoky chorizo, peppers, and paprika-spiked tomato.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs skin-side down until golden, then set aside.
Fry the sliced chorizo until its red oil releases.
Soften the onion, peppers, and garlic in that oil.
Stir in the smoked paprika, then add the tomatoes and stock.
Nestle the chicken back in and simmer until cooked through and saucy.
Serve with crusty bread or rice.

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemon, olives, and warm North African spices.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil, then set aside.
Soften the sliced onions and garlic, then stir in the ginger, turmeric, and cumin.
Return the chicken with a splash of water and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise gently until the chicken is very tender.
Add the chopped preserved lemon and olives in the last ten minutes.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with couscous or bread.

recipes.name: Vegetable couscous tagine
recipes.blurb: A fragrant North African stew of chickpeas and root vegetables over fluffy couscous.
steps: Soften the onion, then stir in the ras el hanout until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots, zucchini, tomatoes, and stock.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and warm through.
Pour boiling stock over the couscous, cover, and let it steam, then fluff with a fork.
Spoon the vegetable stew over the couscous and serve.

recipes.name: Harira
recipes.blurb: A comforting Moroccan tomato, lentil, and chickpea soup brightened with herbs.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and celery, then add the ginger and turmeric.
Stir in the tomatoes and cook briefly to deepen the flavor.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer until the lentils are soft.
Add the chickpeas and warm through.
Blend a portion of the soup to thicken it if you like.
Stir in plenty of chopped cilantro and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Vegan dan dan noodles
recipes.blurb: Springy noodles in a nutty, chili-laced sauce topped with savory crumbled mushrooms.
steps: Finely chop the mushrooms and fry until dark and crisp, seasoned with soy sauce.
Whisk the tahini, remaining soy, chili oil, and garlic with a little hot water into a sauce.
Toast and grind the Sichuan peppercorns.
Cook the noodles until just tender, then drain.
Spoon the sauce into bowls and pile the noodles on top.
Crown with the crispy mushrooms, ground peppercorns, and scallions, then toss to eat.

recipes.name: Black bean tostadas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas heaped with smoky black beans, avocado, and tangy slaw.
steps: Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan or oven until they snap.
Saute the onion, add the drained beans and cumin, and mash to a chunky spread.
Toss the shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt for a quick slaw.
Mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Spread the beans over each tostada.
Top with avocado, slaw, and cilantro and serve right away.

recipes.name: Pasta alla norma
recipes.blurb: Sicilian pasta with fried eggplant, rich tomato sauce, and salty ricotta salata.
steps: Dice the eggplant, salt it, then fry in oil until golden and tender.
Make a quick sauce by simmering the tomatoes with garlic and basil.
Cook the rigatoni until al dente, reserving a little pasta water.
Fold most of the fried eggplant into the sauce.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with pasta water.
Top with the remaining eggplant, grated ricotta salata, and basil.

recipes.name: Falafel plate
recipes.blurb: Crisp herbed chickpea fritters with tahini, salad, and warm pita.
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight, then drain well.
Blitz the chickpeas with the herbs, onion, garlic, and cumin into a coarse paste.
Rest the mixture, then shape into small patties.
Fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp outside.
Loosen the tahini with lemon juice and water into a pourable sauce.
Serve the falafel with tahini, salad, and warm pita.

recipes.name: Shrimp pad krapow
recipes.blurb: Fiery Thai basil stir-fry of shrimp, chiles, and garlic over rice with a crispy egg.
steps: Pound the garlic and chiles into a rough paste.
Fry the eggs in plenty of hot oil until the edges are crisp, then set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic and chiles briefly, then add the shrimp.
Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and toss until the shrimp are cooked.
Throw in the basil and stir just until wilted.
Serve over rice topped with the crispy egg.

recipes.name: Japanese miso ramen
recipes.blurb: A warming bowl of springy noodles in rich miso broth with corn and scallions.
steps: Soft-boil the eggs for about seven minutes, then peel and halve.
Saute the garlic, ginger, and sliced mushrooms in a pot.
Add the stock and bring to a simmer.
Whisk the miso paste with a ladle of broth, then stir it back in without boiling.
Cook the ramen noodles separately and divide between bowls.
Ladle over the broth and top with corn, egg, and scallions.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.blurb: Flaky phyllo pie filled with spinach, herbs, and salty feta.
steps: Wilt the spinach, then squeeze out as much water as possible and chop.
Soften the onion and combine with the spinach, crumbled feta, eggs, and dill.
Brush a baking dish and layer half the phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil.
Spread the spinach filling evenly over the pastry base.
Top with the remaining phyllo, brushing every layer, and score the top.
Bake until deeply golden and crisp, then cool slightly before cutting.

recipes.name: Gambas al ajillo with rice
recipes.blurb: Garlicky sizzling shrimp in chili-spiked olive oil, served over rice.
steps: Warm the olive oil gently with thinly sliced garlic and the dried chiles.
Cook until the garlic is fragrant and just turning gold, not brown.
Stir in the smoked paprika.
Add the shrimp and cook over higher heat until pink and curled.
Toss through chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.
Spoon the shrimp and the garlicky oil over warm rice.

recipes.name: Bun cha
recipes.blurb: Grilled pork patties and noodles served with herbs and a tangy dipping sauce.
steps: Mix the pork with minced shallots, half the garlic, a little fish sauce, and sugar, then form small patties.
Make a dipping sauce from fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, water, and the rest of the garlic.
Grill the patties over high heat until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice noodles and rinse under cool water.
Add the warm patties to the dipping sauce.
Serve the noodles, herbs, and pork together, dipping as you eat.

recipes.name: Mediterranean baked cod
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod roasted with tomatoes, olives, and capers in bright olive oil.
steps: Toss the cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, and garlic with oil in a baking dish.
Roast for ten minutes until the tomatoes begin to burst.
Nestle the cod fillets among the tomatoes and season.
Drizzle with more oil and lemon juice.
Bake until the fish is just opaque and flakes easily.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread or potatoes.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, scooped up with bread.
steps: Soften the sliced peppers and onion in oil until tender.
Add the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer into a thick sauce, seasoning well.
Make wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook gently until the whites set but the yolks stay runny.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread.

recipes.name: Tuscan white bean and kale stew
recipes.blurb: A hearty, brothy pot of white beans, kale, and garlic finished with olive oil.
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add the garlic and cook briefly.
Pour in the stock and add half the beans.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken the broth.
Add the remaining beans and the chopped kale and simmer until tender.
Finish with a generous drizzle of olive oil and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Japchae
recipes.blurb: Chewy Korean glass noodles tossed with colorful vegetables and a sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Boil the glass noodles until chewy, then drain and cut into shorter lengths.
Blanch the spinach and squeeze it dry.
Stir-fry the carrots, mushrooms, and peppers separately until just tender.
Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, and garlic into a dressing.
Toss the noodles, vegetables, and dressing together in a large bowl.
Warm through briefly and serve garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken in a silky, lightly sweet tomato and butter sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger, garlic, and half the garam masala for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken until charred at the edges, then set aside.
Melt the butter and cook the remaining spices until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and simmer until thick, then blend smooth.
Stir in the cream and return the chicken to warm through.
Finish with a little more butter and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Carnitas
recipes.blurb: Mexican pork slow-cooked until tender, then crisped in its own fat for tacos.
steps: Cut the pork into large chunks and season with cumin, oregano, and salt.
Place in a pot with the onion, garlic, bay leaves, and the juice and halves of the orange.
Add water to come halfway up and braise gently until very tender.
Remove the lid and let the liquid cook away so the pork fries in its own fat.
Crisp the pork, turning, until the edges are deeply browned.
Pile into warm tortillas with onion, cilantro, and lime.
